title: kith-chat: Contact/changes and Contact/query
description:
What: Implement Contact/changes and Contact/query JmapHandler structs in kith-chat crate.

Contact/changes algorithm:
1. Deserialize args: { accountId: String, sinceState: String, maxChanges: Option<u32> }.
2. Verify accountId == 'a-self'.
3. Acquire store lock.
4. Call store.contacts().get_changes_since(sinceState)?; on KithError::Validation → return JmapError::state_mismatch().
5. Return json!({ accountId, oldState: sinceState, newState: result.new_state, hasMoreChanges: false, created: result.added, updated: result.updated, destroyed: result.destroyed }).

Contact/query algorithm:
1. Deserialize args: { accountId, filter: Option<Value>, sort: Option<Value>, position: Option<u32>, anchor: Option<String>, limit: Option<u32>, calculateTotal: Option<bool> }.
2. Verify accountId == 'a-self'.
3. Acquire store lock.
4. store.contacts().list()? → all contacts (v1: no server-side filter/sort; client sorts).
5. Extract IDs only from the list.
6. Apply position+limit for pagination.
7. queryState = store.contacts().get_state()?.
8. Return json!({ accountId, queryState, canCalculateChanges: true, position: effective_position, ids: page_of_ids, total: if calculateTotal { Some(total) } else { None } }).

Defensive programming rules:
- sinceState is untrusted string: parse via get_changes_since which validates format.
- position and limit bounds: treat None as 0 and usize::MAX respectively; never overflow.
- filter and sort fields are ignored in v1 but must not panic if present.
- Store lock poison → server_fail.

Agent team:
- Agent R: Read kith-store/src/contact.rs for get_changes_since (new as of KITH-vx6.1) and list signatures. Read kith-jmap/src/lib.rs for JmapError::state_mismatch.
- Agent I: Implement ContactChangesHandler and ContactQueryHandler in kith-chat/src/contact.rs. State approach before writing.
- Agent T: Write tests using hand-constructed state sequences. Oracle: RFC 8620 §5.4/5.5 field names.
- Agent V: cargo test -p kith-chat && clippy && fmt.

Tests:
- Contact/changes with sinceState==currentState → empty created/updated/destroyed
- Contact/changes with sinceState=s-0 after one contact upsert → created contains contact ID
- Contact/changes with malformed sinceState → error response (state_mismatch or invalidArguments)
- Contact/query → returns IDs of all contacts
- Contact/query with position+limit → correct page
